## Decision Summary

Behavioral parity across all supported language implementations is validated through shared, language-neutral contract test specifications. Each language must pass the same behavioral assertions to be release-ready.

## Contract Specification Format

Contracts defined in `contracts/` at the repo root:

```text
contracts/
├── clock.yml
├── logging.yml
├── correlation.yml
├── health.yml
└── ...
```

Each contract defines:

- **Given**: Setup state (inputs, configuration)
- **When**: Action performed (method call with arguments)
- **Then**: Expected outcome (return value, side effect, exception type)

[patterns/application/testing/PTN-APP-TEST-002-cross-language-contract-testing.md#rules]

## Rules

| Rule | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| **Contracts are authoritative** | Implementation differs from contract = implementation is wrong |
| **All languages must pass** | CI blocks release if any language fails any contract |
| **Contracts evolve with interfaces** | New interfaces get new contracts |
| **Edge cases explicit** | Null handling, empty inputs, boundary values specified |
| **Error behavior specified** | Exception/error types for invalid inputs must be consistent |
